items.title: Portugal citizenship now takes 10 years for US citizens
items.content_text: Lei Orgânica 1/2026 (in force 19 May 2026) raised the residence requirement for naturalisation from 5 to 10 years for most nationalities, 7 for CPLP and EU nationals. Applications pending on 19 May 2026 keep the old 5-year rule.

items.title: Portugal D7 and D8 income thresholds rise with the 2026 minimum wage
items.content_text: Minimum wage is €920/month in 2026 (Decreto-Lei 139/2025). D7 needs 1x (€920/month), D8 needs 4x (€3,680/month). National visa fee is €110.

items.title: Spain digital nomad visa: consulates list €2,442/month for 2026
items.content_text: US-based Spanish consulates state 200% of the 2026 monthly minimum wage (€1,221 x 2 = €2,442). Applications filed inside Spain are often assessed at about €2,849 (annual SMI spread over 12 months). Family: +75% for the first member, +25% for each additional one.

items.title: Ireland Critical Skills salary floors raised
items.content_text: Since 1 March 2026: €40,904 for listed occupations with a relevant degree, €68,911 for other eligible occupations, €36,848 for recent graduates. Stamp 4 after 21 months on the permit. Thresholds will be indexed yearly from 2027.

items.title: Italy: digital nomad income bar ~€24,789/year; national visa fee €116
items.content_text: US consulates (Los Angeles, New York) state €24,789/year for the digital nomad visa. The national (type D) visa fee is €116; the €300 figure that circulates is the citizenship application fee.

items.title: Mexico residency thresholds now set in UMA, card fees doubled
items.content_text: The 2025 visa guidelines (DOF 25 July 2025) set solvency in days of UMA: temporary residence 680 days monthly income (MXN 79,770.80) or 11,460 days savings; permanent (pension) 1,140 days (MXN 133,733.40) or 45,850 days. INM card fees for 2026: MXN 11,140.74 (temporary, 1 year), MXN 13,578.96 (permanent).
